objective: User-authorized one-time production promotion of the already QA-passed BUKLOD Main Android runtime 1.3.2 OTA and Expo Hosting web, skipping physical device verification, using existing exact-SHA and runtime-gated manual release workflows unchanged.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source df1e4652bac9858df58b40173483baa4d85ec73d, previous three GitHub QA workflows successful for KL reader fix. app.config.js production Main runtimeVersion 1.3.2, project 23dad7d0-389a-406e-8dec-08965dab85d8, package org.mzbministry.buklod; existing production Android OTA workflow verifies V28 pinned source 2f26645e... and compares exact frozen RC manifest; Expo Hosting workflow exports/builds against production Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu. This promotion retains both original workflows and their preflight checks.
chosenApproach: Temporary one-shot GitHub Actions orchestration workflow activated by an explicitly named merge source commit only. Uses GITHUB_TOKEN actions:write to invoke each existing workflow_dispatch endpoint exactly once; records per-target pending/success/failure SHA statuses via workflow_run completion events. It performs no custom OTA publication and bypasses no release gate. Keep main unchanged while deployments verify.
selectionRationale: The connected GitHub API provides workflow file writes but no direct workflow_dispatch action. A tightly scoped one-time dispatcher with required Actions status recording is the lowest-risk way to execute authorized release through existing workflows without rewriting release logic.
alternativeApproaches: Trigger stale successful run again: rejected because its SHA excludes latest fixes.
Publish via Vercel instead of Expo Hosting: rejected, wrong product/host.
Change production runtime to 1.3.4: rejected, installed V28 expects 1.3.2.
Disable device/native compatibility gates: rejected; only physical verification is skipped.
preserveBehaviors: Do not modify either production release workflow or its guards
Do not affect staging-user, Classroom, database, user content, Android native dependencies, or package lock
Only dispatch on main with explicit one-shot commit message
Never claim a release live solely on workflow dispatch; require completion status and exact publish evidence
acceptanceChecks: Single dispatch to production_android_ota.yml and production_web_deploy.yml for exactly the matching main source
Android must pass pinned-V28 runtime and source-hash frozen RC checks, then live manifest update verification
Expo Hosting web must pass production environment and immutable SHA export/deploy checks
Both actions conclude successfully and per-target statuses reflect real results
